prompt:
Goal: Create a clean side-by-side memory-study diptych of an urban intersection, combining a realistic photo reference on the left and a minimalist illustrated documentation page on the right.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 image, split vertically into two equal halves. Left half is a crisp daytime photograph; right half is an off-white textured paper poster with a small drawing and typewriter-style caption.

Left side: Show a blue sky with a visible pale half moon near the upper center-right of the photo area. Include exactly 3 diagonal overhead utility wires crossing the sky. At the bottom, show a traffic-light assembly with exactly 3 stacked circular signal lenses in a black rectangular housing; the bottom lens glows green with an upward arrow. To the left of the signal, include exactly 1 white traffic sign showing a prohibited turning movement with a red circle and slash. At the lower right edge, partly crop a green street sign reading 22nd Street. Keep the composition slightly cropped and observational, like a casual weekend street snapshot.

Right side: Use warm cream paper with subtle fibers, tiny speckles, and a handmade print texture. In the upper-middle area, draw a simplified green line illustration of the same intersection hardware: exactly 2 vertical green poles, exactly 2 curved signal arms, exactly 1 small traffic-light box with three red/orange/green circles, exactly 1 small no-turn sign, and exactly 1 green street-name placard reading 22nd Street. Add a few thin gray-blue overhead wire lines behind the poles. The drawing should look slightly imperfect, like a rubber-stamp or risograph sketch.

Text content on the paper: Beneath the drawing, aligned left, add a small monospaced typewriter caption in black with four lines: "22ND STREET & MISS'ION" / "No. 002" / "URBAN. SIGNAGE. INTERSECTION." / "2024".

Visual style: The left side should be photographic with natural light, saturated blue sky, realistic shadows, and slight street-photo cropping. The right side should be minimalist, archival, and tactile, with muted green, red, black, and gray-blue ink on aged paper. Keep the two halves aligned cleanly with no border between them.

Constraints: No people, no cars, no extra signs beyond the counted elements, no watermark, no decorative frame, and avoid adding unreadable invented text.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张记录城市路口记忆的双联海报，左侧为写实照片，右侧为极简主义插画现场笔记，标题围绕 22ND STREET & MISS'ION 展开。

画布：横向 4:3 图像，垂直平分为两半。左半部分为写实裁剪的街头摄影；右半部分为米白色纹理纸张插画页。无外边框。

左侧照片部分：展示一片清澈的深蓝色白昼天空，左侧面板中上部偏右可见一轮苍白的半月。包含恰好 2 根斜跨天空的架空电线：一根靠近顶部向右上方倾斜，另一根穿过中部向右下方倾斜。底部边缘裁剪入一个城市交通信号灯组：恰好 1 个黑色垂直三灯信号灯，底部灯光亮起绿松石色向上箭头，顶部和中部圆形灯光熄灭；左侧恰好 1 个方形“禁止左转/禁止掉头”类禁令标志，黑色转弯箭头上有红色圆圈和斜杠；右下边缘部分可见一个绿色路名牌，仅显示“22……”的开头。照片应具有手持拍摄和轻微变焦的质感，伴有自然阳光和真实的阴影。

右侧插画部分：使用带有细微纹理、斑点和微小纤维的暖色奶油纸。用深绿色、柔和的红色、黑色和灰色绘制同一路口的稀疏丝网印刷或孔版印刷风格素描。包含恰好 2 根绿色交通信号灯杆（左侧一根，右侧一根），由架空横臂连接。包含恰好 1 个带有 3 个堆叠红/黄/绿圆圈的小型交通信号盒、恰好 1 个小型禁止转弯标志、恰好 1 个写有 22nd Street 的绿色路牌，以及在信号灯后方和上方绘制的恰好 3 根细灰色架空电线。插画应简洁、略显不完美，并具有胶印纹理。

右侧面板文字内容：在插画下方，放置一个左对齐的小型打字机风格标题。使用恰好 4 行等宽黑色文字：第 1 行：22ND STREET & MISS'ION；第 2 行：No. 002；第 3 行：“URBAN. SIGNAGE. INTERSECTION.”；第 4 行：2024。请保持默认标题中的撇号/特殊拼写完全不变。

视觉风格：编辑类旅行记忆杂志，模拟街头摄影搭配简洁的城市标识素描。右侧应看起来像印刷的纪念卡或目录页；左侧应保持摄影质感。使用克制的色彩、大量的留白以及怀旧的周末记录氛围。

约束：保持精确的垂直分割；不要添加人物、汽车、建筑物、额外的标志、额外的标题、徽标或水印。除照片侧裁剪出的部分“22……”外，所有可见文字仅限于指定的路牌和四行标题。
